title: "Basic Statistics"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates basic statistical operations on a small matrix using the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Dataset

```{r data}
a <- matrix(c(1.1, 4, 2.213, 5.013, 3.3, 6), nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
print(a)
```

## Statistics

```{r stats}
means <- da_mean(a, axis = "row")
cat(sprintf("Row means: %s\n", paste(means, collapse = " ")))

harmonic_means <- da_harmonic_mean(a, axis = "col")
cat(sprintf("Column harmonic means: %s\n", paste(harmonic_means, collapse = " ")))

var <- da_variance(a, axis = "all")
cat(sprintf("Overall data variance: %s\n", var))

medians <- da_quantile(a, 0.5, axis = "row")
cat(sprintf("Row medians: %s\n", paste(medians, collapse = " ")))

covar <- da_covariance_matrix(a)
cat("Covariance matrix:\n")
print(covar)

standardized <- da_standardize(a)
cat("Standardized matrix:\n")
print(standardized)
```
